create_get_config_train: create a sorting task config for training mode with two colored sprites and goal positions
create_get_config_test: create a sorting task config for test mode using the held-out color pair combination
run_get_config: run the sorting task config generator with train or test mode to produce environment kwargs
review_get_config: review the get_config function that builds subtasks, sprite generators, and meta-aggregated task
summarize_get_config: summarize the get_config function that generates a COBRA sorting environment configuration dictionary
